evidence: Render_SubmitPlayerSprites reads the four-byte word at 0x00001CB2 as its VDP control value.
System_InitializeRuntime initializes the HUD frame cursor to 0x000029A6.
Render_BuildActorRecords advances the cursor by one word and wraps to 0x000029A8 when the 0x000029DE sentinel is reached.
The sequence ends immediately before the separately bounded Level-08 VDP record table at 0x000029E0.
